_comment: Per-(stem, preset) drift: `mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-OptiQ-2bit` is an OptiQ mixed-bit checkpoint. Its section default is this preset's own 4-bit / g64 affine, and its `quantization_config` lists every quantized module on its own — 614 per-module entries, copied here verbatim and in the checkpoint's order (501 at 4-bit, 113 at 2-bit; every entry `{bits, group_size}` with gs 64). 2-bit is the routed experts only: `switch_mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj` on layers 5-41 (all three) and layer 42 (gate/up — its `down_proj` is 4-bit); layers 0-4 and 43-47 are fully 4-bit, and so is everything else (router `mlp.gate`, shared expert and its gate, full-attn q/k/v/o, the linear_attn projections, `embed_tokens`, `lm_head`). A per-module map is authoritative (an unlisted module is dense), so this map alone decides every width the build reads; it cannot live in an arch-wide preset (#202: an arch-wide map makes every other checkpoint of the arch unloadable). The OptiQ vision sidecar (`optiq_vision`, BF16, `optiq/optiq_vision.safetensors` — outside the shard index, never fetched) is a top-level config key that never enters the compiled config. CAUTION: unlike nemotron-h-latent, this arch's gated routed-expert stacks carry no fingerprint rows (`affine_tensors_of` skips `switch_mlp` leaves), so the 2-bit expert axis has no load-time coverage — this variant is kept apart from its 35B siblings by shape alone, and a future uniform-4-bit 122B variant would collide with it in the loader's packed-width assert; that variant needs a gated-experts arm in `affine_tensors_of` first.
